messages:
maria (eng-security): quick heads-up — upstream released a runc patch (runc CVE-2026-0001) that affects container startup privilege escalation on some kernels. we should schedule a base-image rebuild + canary rollout. also need to backfill audit logs for the last 48h because our build-service role was temporarily broadened last week.

omar (eng-runtime): ok, timeline? can we do an automated rebuild and push to staging only first?

lee (eng-infra): staging push + canary sounds good. i'll freeze the build queue for 10m when we cut the new images. need @matt to confirm KMS signing perms for the new signer principal — we changed a role last sprint.

matt (sec): i saw the role tweak. current signer principal (projects/redwood/keys/build-signer) lost iam.cryptoSignApk last week in the emergency change. i'll re-grant but prefer a scoped short-lived key for the rebuild job.

maria (eng-security): thanks. can we do: 1) rotate signer -> short-lived wrapped key, 2) rebuild images in staging with updated runtime, 3) run vuln scan + runtime smoke tests, 4) canary to 1% traffic, 5) full rollout. also we need audit backfill for any operations performed by build-service between 1724928000 and 1724999999.

lee (eng-infra): noted. i'll create a maintenance window in the calendar for 22:00 UTC tonight. on backfill: infra has exported build logs to gs://redwood-build-logs — who should own correlation with audit logs?

matt (sec): security will own the audit correlation. matt (sec): plan to query Cloud Audit Logs for admin activity and KMS logs for keywrap/unwrapped ops. please grant me access to the build logs GCS path (lee).

lee (eng-infra): granted (acl: security-team@redwood).

sre-bot: deploy-bot: staging rebuild job queued: job-id=rbld-17250-stg, initiator=maria. watch: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/rbld-17250-stg

omar (eng-runtime): quick checklist for rebuild job:
- base image: debian-14 -> apply runc patch + kernel mitigations
- containerd/runtime config: disable unprivileged-userns by default
- entrypoint hardening: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and set no-new-privs
- cosign sign after KMS wrap (use short-lived key)

maria (eng-security): include an explicit audit hook in the pipeline that emits a structured JSON record for each sign/push action. Format: {"actor": "svc:build-service", "action": "image:sign", "key": "k-...", "ts": "..."} — matt can we parse that?

matt (sec): yes, we'll ingest to the security audit index. add the field "rbac_delta" if any manual role grants occur during the window.

lee (eng-infra): smoke test to run after staging image is up:
```
kubectl run runc-test --image=registry.staging.redwood/base:runcpatched --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec": {"containers": [{"securityContext": {"allowPrivilegeEscalation": false}}]}}'
kubectl logs runc-test
```

omar (eng-runtime): i'll also run runtime fuzz harness for 30m against the canary pods. if any kernel oops or unexpected restarts, auto-rollback.

maria (eng-security): vuln triage note: any image regressions from new libs (libsec, libcontainer) should be filed under sec/image-rebuild with priority=high. we'll run SCA and SBOM diff.

lee (eng-infra): regarding audit backfill: matt, what query do you want?

matt (sec): something like:
```
resource.type="k8s_cluster"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"build-service@redwood"
timestamp>="2026-02-25T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-02-27T00:00:00Z"
```
correlate with gs://redwood-build-logs/*/rbld-* and the KMS audit entries for projects/redwood/keys/build-signer.

maria (eng-security): if we detect any signed artifacts pushed with the old signer identity during that window, we need to revoke trust and issue a rapid re-sign plan. document decisions in incident-runbook if that happens.

omar (eng-runtime): one more: runtime config needs a fallback policy. if runc exploit triggered in prod canary, we should route new requests to older runtime variant (runc-legacy) and scale it up for 5m while we investigate. can we add that to the rollout playbook?

lee (eng-infra): yes — will add a canary-fallback step and automations to the runbook.

matt (sec): i'll prep the KMS short-lived key rotation script and run the audit queries after staging push completes. will post findings here.

maria (eng-security): perfect. owners: lee (coord infra windows & pushes), omar (runtime tests & canary policy), matt (KMS + audit correlation), maria (overall sec coord + incident runbook). ping here once staging job finishes (rbld-17250-stg). :thumbsup:

sre-bot: job rbld-17250-stg completed: result=SUCCESS duration=18m. artifacts: gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-17250-stg/ - triggered by maria (eng-security)

maria (eng-security): great — matt, can you kick the audit backfill now?

matt (sec): kicking now. query submitted, will share CSV of correlated events in ~10m.

maria (eng-security): thanks everyone. i'll open the canary rollout ticket and add the fallback conditions. once canary is stable for 30m we'll move to 10% then full.

lee (eng-infra): adding calendar notes + runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/runc-patch-17250

omar (eng-runtime): monitoring hooks: added kprobe alerts for unexpected prctl/ptrace syscalls to the canary rule set.

matt (sec): audit CSV attached to ticket. no suspicious sign/push events found during window. continuing to watch.

maria (eng-security): closing the loop here — thanks all. will keep this thread as the canonical coord record. :lock:
